competing_explanation: The 30-day window may be outdated, promotional, or applicable only to a subset of items rather than all standard items.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items, measured from the date of delivery or receipt.
refutation_criterion: The current authoritative policy states a different return window, requires a different start date, or does not provide full refunds for standard items within 30 days.
